text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate, hard-working full stack developer with 7 years of experience building responsive web applications.

I’d be glad to help design your dark-themed admin panel for a React app, with a focus on clean, usable UI for streamers and content creators. I also understand the importance of keeping the design aligned with MUI components so it’s practical for development and consistent across web and mobile.

One relevant project I’ve worked on was a live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight, where I built a dispatcher map showing every truck’s position and ETA as GPS pings arrived. It tracked 1,800 trucks live and kept ping-to-screen time under 2 seconds.

I’d be happy to work with you beyond this job as well. Will you be providing the existing Figma colors and screens up front, or should I start from a blank layout structure?
